what: M11a step 4 pre-read: 5 alternating rounds, base clocks, every row of the region map (records only, not gated)

protocol.order: A/B alternation (B first in every round)

clocks.how: ncu --clock-control base on parity/clock_lock/clock_holder.cu (idle, one kernel) for the whole A/B; the timed programs are not profiled
clocks.check: every busy GPU sample of every accepted round at the locked clocks

protocol.original: the UNPATCHED copy's bin/hsospBench --hg, B's defaults, --verify none
protocol.port: dyng-compat-hsosp bench --sync-stages --digests (the golden's batches; --threads = the machine's hardware threads, as B's OpenMP default)
protocol.guard: every round: B's h2h_pairs, overflow_rebuilds, seeds and mismatch_static and the port's pairs digest, pair count, CSR rebuilds and (the full update) its distances' and parents' digests and mismatch_static of every batch against the golden; a failure stops the reading. The fallback decisions of both sides against the golden's: a differing round is repeated (at most doubling the rounds), more than a third of differing rounds records 'scope differs' (HD7)
protocol.verdict: maintain[bk] <= 1.03 GO; 1.03-1.05 recorded with a fix plan; above 1.05 fixed (criterion 12)

monitor.rule: a round is repeated if, during either side, the CPUs were busy outside the harness for more than 2.0 cores on average or a foreign compute process was on the timed GPU

rule.why: B's quiet maximum 7.03 is at most 8.0: ADR 0056's thresholds kept (HD4)
